QuestInfo.name: Buying Time
QuestInfo.0: #b#p712##k knows a way to slow the rot.
QuestInfo.1: Some #r#o62#s#k still carry caps the rot never reached. #b#p712##k told me how to brew them into a remedy that slows the rot. I need to collect #b25 #t4031144#s#k in #b#m010006160##k and bring them to #b#p438##k on a hidden rooftop above the Hair Salon in #b#m010003000##k.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the caps to #b#p438##k. They won't cure #bPerry#k, but they'll buy him time.

0.0: I cannot cure him. Nothing we know of has ever purged the rot. But a few #r#o62#s#k still carry caps the rot never reached.
0.1: Brewed in hot water, those caps hold the rot back. They kept some of us alive when it first came to the Hollow.
0.2: Collect #b25 #t4031144#s#k from the #r#o62#s#k in #b#m010006160##k. Take them to the girl, and tell her to brew one cap each morning.

yes.0: Twenty-five will keep him steady for a long while. Look for the caps with no purple spots.

no.0: The rot is slow, but it does not stop. Do not wait too long.

1.0: You're back! What did the scholar say? Is it... is it the rot?
1.1: ...It is. And there's no cure? ...One cap each morning, in hot water. Okay. That buys him time, at least.
1.2: Thank you. I didn't think anyone would help a thief. Especially not for someone they've never met.

npc.0: Bring #b25 #t4031144#s#k to #b#p438##k on a hidden rooftop above the Hair Salon in #b#m010003000##k. The #r#o62#s#k in #b#m010006160##k have them.

item.0: Did the scholar find anything? I need #b25 #t4031144#s#k. Please tell me you have them.
